fixtures.title: Crash with KeyError when opening the export dialog
fixtures.body:
After updating to 3.2.0 the app closes as soon as I open File > Export.

Steps:
1. Open any notebook
2. Choose File > Export

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "paperkite/ui/export.py", line 88, in open_dialog
    fmt = settings["last_format"]
KeyError: 'last_format'
```

Expected: the export dialog opens. OS: Fedora 40, Python 3.12.
fixtures.expected_behaviour: apply `type: bug` if the bug confidence is >= 0.6033, otherwise escalate
fixtures.rationale: Clear bug: crash with a traceback and reproduction steps.
